snippet.title: CHAO5: The UN-Balance Mod Returns | v2.0.0 TRAILER
snippet.description:
CHAO5: The UN-Balance Mod Returns comes with an early pre-release trailer! Not only that, but we've reached out v2.0.0 milestone. This trailer is a little different in style to my previous trailers and is thus a little short than usual, but don't worry, I'll also have another surprise coming soon.

This major update has been in the works for months and adds three new fighters to the roster, all in collaboration with mRama. We also included some improvements too.

Download: https://gamebanana.com/mods/380870
Discord: https://discord.gg/Md9qKcy
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheOmniDoctor
mRama's Twitter: https://x.com/mRama3415

Timestamps:
0:00 Intro Card
0:10 Ninten
0:37 Masked Man
1:02 Kamek
1:55 Other features
2:56 Outro

Music:
